findings.finding: Active host metadata read delays the cooperative loop beyond cap; SIGINT and SIGKILL of still-live owned native groups occur at620 for cap600. No independent timer or watchdog interrupts this own read.

generic_required_condition: The original absolute native cutoff must remain enforceable while active monitor metadata reads or process scans are blocked. Late cleanup and a false qualification result do not retroactively bound live native occupancy. After positively observed native absence, host receipt bookkeeping may be separately charged outside this native proof interval; that separation does not permit pre-absence blocking.
